name: C
summary: C the way CS50 and embedded-systems courses teach it: printf and scanf, types, decisions, loops, arrays, functions, strings, pointers and structs, ending with a sensor-log report like the ones Arduino projects need. Graded by real tests.

levels.name: Basics: printf/scanf, types, decisions, loops, arrays, functions, strings, pointers, structs
Memory: malloc/free, dynamic arrays, linked lists
Files, the command line, and multi-file programs with headers and make
Embedded: registers, interrupts, timers, Arduino without the Arduino library
Algorithms and data structures in C
Professional craft: debugging (gdb), sanitizers, testing, security
Capstone: firmware or a tool for a real need, then a defense

certs: Harvard CS50x (free) uses C for its first half
C Programming Institute CLA (entry level) covers Levels 1-2
